title: Classify delegate input races as usage errors
body:
Review round 2 of PR #112 (`.krn/runs/claude-cli-exit-codes/deliver/review-c224a121.log`) found that `delegate` path checks after the first catch blocks (`lstat` at `src/cli/delegate.ts:429`, `ensurePinnedPath` realpath/lstat at `:328`) let `ENOENT`/`ENOTDIR`/`ELOOP` from a concurrently removed `--input` escape as host errors (exit 70 instead of 64), and that worker host failures become a `failed` result with exit 1 (`:720`, `:798`) — pre-existing behaviour.
Acceptance: every user-path syscall in delegate preflight maps those codes to usage exit 64 with a test that removes the input between checks; decide and document whether worker host failures stay results (exit 1) or exit 70.
